chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamadani (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them).

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Do not consider four things to be bad, for they are four [beneficial]: Do not consider nasal discharge (catarrh) to be bad, for it is a protection from leprosy; do not consider boils to be bad, for they are a protection from vitiligo; do not consider eye inflammation (conjunctivitis) to be bad, for it is a protection from blindness; and do not consider coughing to be bad, for it is a protection from hemiplegia.
ai.seo_question: What are the four ailments that protect against more severe diseases according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq includes this hadith in *Al-Khisal* to illustrate the concept of *al-mukhaffaf li-l-shiddah* (lightening the burden), where minor afflictions serve as expiation or prevention for more severe conditions. This reflects the Shia understanding of divine wisdom in physical trials, viewing these ailments not merely as punishments but as protective mechanisms ordained by God. The narration emphasizes a positive, patient perspective on common illnesses, aligning with the broader theological principle that every hardship carries a hidden benefit.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-32 Ahmad ibn Zyad ibn Ja’far al-Hamedany - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim quoted his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, on the authority of Qiyath ibn Ibrahim,on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq (MGB), on the authority of his father (MGB), on the authority of his forefathers (MGB), on the authority of Ali (MGB) that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “Do not consider the following four things to be bad since they have four benefits. Do not consider influenza to be bad since it brings security from vitiligo . Do not consider imposthume to be bad since it brings security from leprosy. Do not consider eye pain to be bad since it brings security from going blind. Do not consider coughing to be bad since it makes you secure from hemiplegia. ”
